description: This file declares utility functions and macros for nl80211 wireless interface attribute handling, including type conversions, attribute fetching, and band/bandwidth mappings.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getWiphy
methods.description: Fetches the Wiphy ID from nl80211 attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getIfIndex
methods.description: Fetches the interface netdev index from nl80211 attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getIfName
methods.description: Retrieves the interface netdev name from nl80211 attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwNlToSwl
methods.description: Converts nl80211 bandwidth ID to SWL bandwidth enum.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwSwlToNl
methods.description: Converts SWL bandwidth enum to nl80211 bandwidth ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwNlToVal
methods.description: Converts nl80211 bandwidth ID to bandwidth in MHz.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwValToNl
methods.description: Converts bandwidth in MHz to nl80211 bandwidth ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_freqBandSwlToNl
methods.description: Converts SWL frequency band enum to nl80211 band enum.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_freqBandNlToSwl
methods.description: Converts nl80211 band enum to SWL frequency band enum.
